items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Where did you work with Wesley Dones? ... Well, we worked all around the city

ctx.x: Where did you work with Wesley Dones?

So where did you work with Wesley Dones? Well, we worked all around the city, until we'd give a dance ourselves with the rest of Baton Rouge. And then we got to play the concert. And after that, the right thing we got traded by the old band. And when they got ready to hire, we had so many dates we couldn't make it. So we'd give it to Bob Lyons. And Bob Lyons sent them 75 dollars deposit. And somehow, they wrote back to us and told him they didn't care for him so much he could keep the money, you know. So they…
Ask him who he would use on second cornet.
